headline.en:
My alarm won't stop
until I say what I'd do
on my last day
headline.ja:
今日が最後の日なら
何をしたいか声に出すまで
止まらない目覚まし

answer.en:
Leave on time
Really talk with my wife
answer.ja:
定時で帰って
妻とちゃんと話す

headline.en:
Every morning my alarm
asks what I'd do
if today were my last day
headline.ja:
もし今日が最後の日なら
何をしたいか
毎朝問いかける目覚まし

answer.en:
I'll apologize to the friend
I've been avoiding
answer.ja:
ずっと避けていた友達に
謝る

headline.en:
This alarm turns my
"someday" into a promise
I have to say out loud
headline.ja:
いつかやると言っていたことを
今日やると声に出して誓う
目覚まし

answer.en:
I finish that unfinished song
Today
answer.ja:
作りかけの曲を完成させる
今日こそ
